q: Towns that sell a lot get very rich: late in a run each holds 100,000+ gold. The Crown's Take button moves 1,000 gold from a Town into your treasury, and you may press it every 2 minutes on every Town. With 7 Towns that is up to 3,500 gold a minute, while the Tariff (meant to be your main income) brings about 1,300 a minute at that point. So pressing Take beats letting Towns trade. Should Take be limited?
ctx: Today a Take costs the Town only a short mood dip (−30 happiness for 1 minute). The Tariff is 30% of every trade between Towns.
o: Yes: Take can only pull the Tax the Town earned since your last Take
Yes: keep 1,000 gold, but only once every 5 minutes per Town
No: leave Take as it is

q: Your note says the Tariff is a stable 30% with no research for it. The slider is gone. Two research nodes still raise the Tariff: Tax Ledgers (+3%) and Grand Bureaucracy (+7%). Remove them too, so the Tariff is always exactly 30%?
o: Yes: remove both; the Tariff is always 30%
No: keep the two bonuses (30% to 40%)
